scientific_hold: The development gate showed genuine search deepening but omitted a direct route-fusion gate. Five of six final answers equalled the best current two-stage single-view answer; one protected stage-1 route-pool answer was strictly better. Confirmation therefore adds a stricter, claim-aligned gate without changing the algorithm.
panel_reason: A fresh seed and previously unused staged-candidate size levels test both a smaller and the largest China81 scale in every region. Case suffix and thresholds were fixed before any confirmation result was run.
route_fusion_definition: The final complete-model objective must be strictly lower than min(HGS-F, HGS-E, HGS-M) from the same two-stage run by more than 1e-9. Merely selecting the best single-view answer does not count.
failure_rule: Reject unchanged if any invariant fails, fewer than three tasks improve over protected stage 1, either HGS-E or HGS-M is beaten on fewer than three tasks, fewer than two tasks show strict route-fusion improvement over the best current single view, or fewer than five trajectories meet the genuine complete-incumbent shape gate. Do not alter depth, checkpoints, seed, cases, MIP limits, budget cap, or thresholds after results.
claim_boundary: Confirmation only. Passing authorizes formal algorithm freeze and a complete corrected E2 rerun; it is not itself paper evidence.
